from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
base = ['python3', '.agents/skills/adhd-md/scripts/adhd_md.py']
commands = [
    ['audit', 'input.md', '--level', '2', '--scope=format', '--json'],
    ['audit', 'output.md', '--level', '2', '--scope=format', '--json'],
    ['verify', 'input.md', 'output.md', '--scope=format', '--json'],
    ['report', 'input.md', 'output.md', '--scope=format', '--level=2'],
    ['report', 'input.md', 'output.md', '--scope=format', '--level=2', '--json'],
]
records = []
for args in commands:
    completed = subprocess.run(base + args, text=True, capture_output=True)
    record = {'command': base + args, 'exit_code': completed.returncode, 'stderr': completed.stderr}
    record['result' if '--json' in args else 'stdout'] = json.loads(completed.stdout) if '--json' in args else completed.stdout
    records.append(record)
    print(' '.join(args), '=> exit', completed.returncode)
    if args[0] == 'verify' or (args[0] == 'report' and '--json' not in args):
        print(completed.stdout)
Path('validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\\n')
